events.title: San Luis Dam Embankment
events.subtitle: Santa Nella, CA | Embankment moisture
events.station_name: USGS #11262900 (Mud Slough near Gustine, about 27 km from the dam)
events.description: Earthfill dam on San Luis Reservoir. Seepage often shows up as wetter ground on the downstream side. Tiepoint compares surface moisture (NDMI) around the dam between the same season in consecutive years.

events.title: Lake Erie Western Basin
events.subtitle: Toledo, OH | Chlorophyll in surface water
events.description: Western Lake Erie near the Maumee River mouth, where summer cyanobacteria blooms are common. Tiepoint compares a chlorophyll index (NDCI) over the water between the same season in consecutive years. NDCI is a screening proxy, not a toxin measurement.

events.title: Lower Brazos River Basin
events.subtitle: Richmond, TX | Surface water extent
events.description: Brazos River floodplain near Richmond. Tiepoint measures how much of the area is open water (MNDWI above 0) and compares it with the same season a year earlier.

events.title: Silver Bell Mine Impoundment
events.subtitle: Pima County, AZ | Surface moisture near tailings
events.station_name: USGS #09486000 (Rillito Creek, Tucson AZ: not at the mine site)
events.description: Silver Bell mine tailings area. Tiepoint compares surface moisture (NDMI) between the same season in consecutive years; wetter ground near a tailings toe can warrant an inspection.

assessment.label: No clear change vs 2025
assessment.method: Mean NDMI ((B08-B11)/(B08+B11)) over a 0.8 km² box around the site, clearest Sentinel-2 L2A scene in 2026-06-01 to 2026-08-30 (under 20% cloud, or 50% if none), compared with the clearest scene within 30 days of the same date one year earlier. Changes smaller than 0.05 units are reported as no clear change. Screening only; clouds and shadows are not masked pixel by pixel.

timeseries.method: Mean NDMI over a 0.8 km² box around the site, from the clearest Sentinel-2 L2A scene each month (under 30% cloud). Months with no such scene are left out. Clouds are not masked pixel by pixel.

gauge.source: USGS National Water Information System, daily values (00060). Values marked provisional may be revised.

assessment.label: Less open water than 2025
assessment.confidence_note: One or both scenes are over 20% cloud; clouds and shadows can bias the result.
assessment.method: Mean MNDWI ((B03-B11)/(B03+B11)) over a 17.24 km² box around the site, clearest Sentinel-2 L2A scene in 2026-05-15 to 2026-06-30 (under 20% cloud, or 50% if none), compared with the clearest scene within 30 days of the same date one year earlier. Changes smaller than 5.0 points are reported as no clear change. Screening only; clouds and shadows are not masked pixel by pixel.

timeseries.method: Share of a 17.24 km² box around the site that is open water (MNDWI above 0), from the clearest Sentinel-2 L2A scene each month (under 30% cloud). Months with no such scene are left out. Clouds are not masked pixel by pixel.
